summary: A drum synth and sequencer firmware that began as a port of the Erica Synths LXR-02 drum machine, with seven drum tracks and many added engines, filters and generative tools.
features: LXR-02's six voices on seven tracks; 29 extra engines incl. Rings and Plaits
32 patterns of up to 64 steps, parameter locks, trig conditions, ratchets
Euclid, Grids, Turing and cellular generators; "SPELLS" and "WANDER"
18 filter types, FX bus, delay, four reverbs and sidechain compressor
400+ parameters by CC or NRPN, clock in and out, 8-channel USB audio
LXR-02's 85 factory kits built in; imports .SND kits and projects
